title: Revision desk, pathways pass
prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph of a university student's revision desk at night under a warm desk lamp: a large sheet of plain paper covered in a hand-drawn cycle of circles joined by curved arrows in three coloured pens, with no writing on it at all, a fan of blank white index cards held by a bulldog clip, three plain unbranded highlighters, a mechanical pencil, the edge of a closed laptop at the frame edge, a half-finished mug of tea, a soft pool of lamplight fading to shadow at the corners, cosy and focused mood
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
